findings.what: `open_or_refresh_config_pane` also runs when a reply only refreshes a config pane that is already open. Clearing `keymap_open` unconditionally there means a routine refresh, such as the re-read after a write, closes a help overlay the operator opened over that same pane, even though the body kind never changed; the commit only means to close it when a different body replaces the one under it.
